what_is_coupled: One universal pair: metric ↔ stress-energy, strength G. Quantum fields couple to a classical metric. Their vacuum couples through the same G and overshoots Λ. That is the start. The three SM gauges are a different coupling.

pairs.name: Einstein
pairs.note: Universal. Everything with energy sources curvature the same way. One constant, G.

pairs.name: equivalence
pairs.note: The same metric enters every species. That is why gravity is not a fourth SM gauge click.

pairs.name: Lambda
pairs.status: working as a term; origin open
pairs.note: Observed. Sits on the left of Einstein. Not derived from the SM vacuum.

pairs.name: QFT_on_curved
pairs.note: Hawking, inflation perturbations, etc. Fields are quantum. Geometry is not.

pairs.name: vacuum_to_gravity
pairs.note: This coupling is why ρ_Λ is a problem. Naive QFT vacuum overshoots the observed Λ by a huge factor. Not a pass.

pairs.name: hierarchy
pairs.note: Gravity is weak at v because M_Pl is huge. A fact. Not a derivation.

pairs.name: graviton_to_SM
pairs.status: not established as a complete theory
pairs.note: Effective EFT exists (soft gravitons). A finite UV theory that outputs G and Λ is not on the desk.

pairs.name: gauge3_to_G
pairs.status: not coupled in any screened program
pairs.note: The screen: MSSM-class can meet the three gauges. None of them output G from that same map.

why_the_score_cared: lock-R, Born, and Shapley all put mass on log(ρ_Λ^{1/4}/v) and log(M_Pl/v) because those are the two leftovers of this one coupling.
how_far: named the actual couple: (g_μν, T_μν) with strength G
leftovers: vacuum→gravity (fail as a prediction), hierarchy (open as a fact)
graviton↔SM is EFT-open, not a UV F
gauge3 is not coupled to G in any screened program
start here; do not glue a GUT meet onto this pair
next_da_move: Stay on this pair. A nature4 pass needs G and Λ as outputs of one F. That F is not on the desk.
